description: Makes the sound of any video: ElevenLabs voiceover (one file per line, static levelling, a transcript gate that must hear brand names verbatim, word timings for captions), music picked by role and tempo from a beat-mapped library and cut to the film, sound effects from an analysed library of 1,277 redistributable sounds or generated, the stereo mix that ducks music per spoken passage with a static master to -14 LUFS, and the check that every effect is heard. An executor under video-studio. Use when a film needs a voice, music, effects or a mix, or when video-studio reaches its audio steps. Triggers: "voiceover", "voice the script", "music bed", "sound design", "sound effects", "mix the audio", "loudness", "install the sound library".
